runnerNote: STEP-5 RUNNER NOTE: VOID exactly as the plan expected, and with a real control — a BYTE-IDENTICAL hook spec fired at the project tier in the same probe, so the managed hooks silence is NOT a malformed spec: the same spec fires one tier down. What the run does NOT establish is WHICH mechanism swallows it — three readings produce an identical VOID and nothing observed here separates them: (1) the CLI restrictive-key filter drops hooks from managedSettings; (2) SDK-side filtering removes it before the CLI ever sees it; (3) managed hooks require a real on-disk admin tier, which no fixture has. All three delete the same design branch, so the established finding is that the managed-hooks path does not fire in this configuration, by one of three indistinguishable mechanisms. This deletes the managedSettings.hooks design branch.
auditCorrection: POST-AUDIT CORRECTION (2026-07-28) — ANALYSIS TEXT ONLY. No measured field in this file was altered: positive=false, negativeControl=true, verdict=VOID and notes are exactly as the run produced them. THE VOID STANDS and the decision it drives is unchanged. RETRACTED from runnerNote, quoted verbatim as it stood before this edit: 'so the managed hooks silence is the CLI restrictive-key filter dropping the key, not a malformed spec'. The second half of that clause is sound and is kept — the byte-identical project-tier control firing in the same probe does rule out a malformed spec. The first half is an OVER-claim: the run attributes a cause it cannot distinguish. Three readings produce an identical VOID — the CLI restrictive-key filter, SDK-side filtering before the CLI sees the key, or managed hooks requiring a real on-disk admin tier that no fixture has — and the probe records nothing that separates them. The attribution is therefore softened to what was actually established: the managed-hooks path does not fire in this configuration, by one of three indistinguishable mechanisms. Separating them would take a different experiment (e.g. an on-disk admin-tier fixture), which Phase 1.1 does not need. See probes/README.md, correction (b).
